notes.title: Important changes in the bundle
notes.notes:
Friends,

We have been receiving messages from players that some of the games that make up the bundle are not working correctly. We investigated the problem and realized that we had to replace two games:
Behind the Reflection 2: Witch's Revenge
Vampire Saga: Pandora's Box

We are sorry to part with these games, but in return we updated the bundle and added two projects:
Dark Angels: Masquerade of Shadows
Sacra Terra: Kiss of Death

We hope that the new games will bring you a lot of fun! Thank you for understanding.

UPD. We've received your feedback and it was clear that you were not happy with our decision. That's why we revised it and added Behind the Reflection 2: Witch's Revenge and Vampire Saga: Pandora's Box back as bonus games.
Thanks a lot for your concern!
